repos.name: Surreal
repos.title: Surreal Prompt Studio
repos.description: Builds surreal image prompts from a device, subject, meaning and medium. Fix the parts you care about, leave the rest to chance, and generate up to six ideas per run.
repos.pageDescription: Combine a surreal device, a subject, a meaning and a medium. Fix the parts you care about, leave the rest to chance.

repos.name: Lissajous
repos.title: Lissajous Lab
repos.description: Feed one sine wave into each axis and a dot draws a Lissajous figure. Change the frequency ratio and phase, add a trace pen or drift, and play the curve as stereo tones.
repos.pageDescription: Feed one sine wave into the horizontal axis and another into the vertical, and the dot draws a Lissajous figure. Change the frequency ratio, shift the phase, and watch the shape answer back.

repos.name: Proportion
repos.title: Proportion Studio
repos.description: Set up a fashion shoot, then push any body part or garment bigger or smaller with sliders. The image prompt rewrites itself as you go, for Midjourney or Stable Diffusion.
repos.pageDescription: Set up the shoot, pick a wardrobe, then push any body part or garment bigger or smaller. Every slider starts at normal and the prompt rewrites itself as you go.

repos.name: angle
repos.title: Contact Angle
repos.description: Grows Islamic star patterns from a plain tiling. Two rays leave each edge midpoint and meet as stars; tune the contact angle, offset and rotation, then animate the construction.
repos.pageDescription: Grow star patterns from a plain tiling. Two rays leave the middle of every edge; where they meet, a star forms.

repos.name: Iqa
repos.title: Iqa Rhythm Studio
repos.description: Build rhythmic cycles from Arab, Turkish and Persian traditions on four drum lanes, write A, B and fill variations, and export audio or MIDI.
repos.pageDescription: Build rhythmic cycles from the Arab, Turkish and Persian traditions on four lanes: lead drum, frame drum, finger cymbals and bass drum. Drag strokes onto the cycle, shape each hit's dynamics, write A, B and Fill…

repos.name: Specimen
repos.title: Specimen Loop
repos.description: Turns one photo into a seamless liquid-warp loop with tracker labels and glitch bursts. Every term in the motion formula is a slider; exports MP4 or GIF.
repos.pageDescription: Turn one photo into a seamless liquid-warp loop with a tracker-label overlay and glitch bursts. Every term in the movement formula is a slider. Exports MP4 or GIF.

repos.name: synth
repos.title: Equation Synth
repos.description: Write y = f(x) and a dot sweeps along x, playing the curve's height as pitch. Layer equations like instruments and save MP4 or WAV.
repos.pageDescription: Write y = f(x). A dot sweeps along x and plays the height y as pitch, the same trick as the graphing-calculator video. Click anywhere on the graph to play from that point.
